text: Wizz Air is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker WIZZ. Wizz Air Holdings Plc has four airline subsidiaries: Wizz Air Hungary Ltd., Wizz Air UK Limited, Wizz Air Malta Ltd. and Wizz Air Abu Dhabi LLC.
